ma.getFileInfo(Object object)

Obtain file information.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
filePath String Yes Local file path.
digestAlgorithm String 'md5' No Algorithm for calculating the file digest.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)
object.digestAlgorithm
Valid Value Description
sha256 sha256 algorithm(default)
md5 MD5 algorithm. The encryption algorithm is insecure. SHA256 is recommended.
sha1 SHA1 algorithm. The encryption algorithm is insecure. SHA256 is recommended.
object.success Callback Function
Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String getFileInfo:ok
size Number File size, in byte.
digest String File digest calculated based on the input digestAlgorithm.

Sample Code

ma.getFileInfo({
  filePath: 'filePath',
  success(res) {
    console.log(res.size);
    console.log(res.digest);
  }
});

Tips

  1. Support calling through FileSystemManager
